mentions.name: Miletus
mentions.description: A personal learning agent that asks the user daily questions, emails interesting reads in chosen topics (math, LLMs, RL, robotics), and helps track progress in learning. Started as a web app and now ported to a Mac desktop app, positioned as "Conductor, but for your learning side quests".
mentions.source_excerpt:
I ended up building a personal agent that asks me questions every day, emails me interesting reads in these areas, and helps me progress in my learning.

It started as a web app, but I have just ported it to a Mac desktop app.

It works like Conductor, but for your learning side quests: https://miletus.app
mentions.author: thedreammachine
